title: PAX wall-mounted storage frame
description: PAX wall-mounted storage frame, gray-beige, 195/8x227/8x927/8" PAX storage frame comes as a foldable construction that you open like a book. This means that you can assemble it on the exact spot where you want to place your furniture – and avoid heavy lifting.
features: Doors, hinges and interiors are sold separately.
Two people are needed to assemble this furniture.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The frame can be assembled in an upright position if your ceiling height is a minimum of 93¼". Follow the assembly instructions in the package.
If you want to complete your PAX frame with a sliding door, the minimum ceiling height required is 94½".

When assembling a corner storage solution, start with the corner add-on unit. This is necessary in order to be able to attach all required parts to PAX foldable wall-mounted storage frame in the next step.
For PAX foldable wall-mounted storage frame, leave a distance of 2.5"/ 6.3 cm from the wall/corner when attaching the wall rail. For a solution with an add-on corner unit, leave 7.6"/19.3 cm.
May be completed with SKUBB storage case 16.93x20.87x7.48 inches which is dimensioned for this wardrobe frame.
